Qikbar 0.2.1 — MIT licensed, https://qikbar.com/
Official ESM index, search utilities and browser chunks from @qikbar/qikbar.
Files are unmodified; LICENSE and manifest.json record provenance and SHA-256 hashes.
Self-hosted for Ferravex website search at the user's request. No framework, CDN,
account, telemetry or engine/game runtime dependency is added.
package.json is only an ESM scope marker for local tests, not an install manifest.
